mentions.name: App Shot Editor
mentions.description: A free screenshot generator for iOS and Google App Store listings, making it easy to create the screenshots needed for app store pages.
mentions.problem: Creating the screenshots needed for app store listings was not easy, especially for beginners like the author's kids getting into mobile app development.
mentions.audience: kids entering mobile app development who need an easy way to create the screenshots required for their app store listings
mentions.source_excerpt: Also working on App Shot Editor [1], a free iOS/Google App store screenshot generator. Basically my kids were getting into mobile app development, and I wanted an easy way for them to create the screenshots needed for the app store listing.

evidence.value: Also working on App Shot Editor [1], a free iOS/Google App store screenshot generator. Basically my kids were getting into mobile app development, and I wanted an easy way for them to create the screenshots needed for the app store listing.
